description: Header file defining a circular_deque container class with iterator support, memory management, and various container operations, similar to std::deque but with a flat circular buffer implementation.

classes.name: base::circular_deque
classes.description: A circular buffer-based deque container with iterator support, dynamic resizing, and element access.

classes.name: base::internal::circular_deque_const_iterator
classes.description: Const iterator for circular_deque, supporting random access and iterator operations.

classes.name: base::internal::circular_deque_iterator
classes.description: Mutable iterator for circular_deque, inheriting from const iterator, supporting random access and iterator operations.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying or moving deques.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns new contents to the deque from a range or count and value.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Access element at index with bounds checking.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Access element at index without bounds checking.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserve capacity for at least the specified number of elements.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resize the deque to a specified size, optionally filling new elements.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Insert elements at a specified position.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Construct element in-place at a specified position.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Erase element(s) at a specified position.
